_meta.scope: macOS only; Windows is unmeasured (WP-30 M4)

amp.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, saving("<dir>/tw_R&D.gph", replace) nodraw

bang.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, saving("<dir>/tw_bang!x!y.gph", replace) nodraw

caret.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, saving("<dir>/tw_caret^x.gph", replace) nodraw

dotdot.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, saving("<dir>/sub/../tw_dotdot.gph", replace) nodraw

gt.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, saving("<dir>/tw_a>b.gph", replace) nodraw

lt.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, saving("<dir>/tw_a<b.gph", replace) nodraw

pct_path.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, saving("<dir>/tw_pct%PATH%x.gph", replace) nodraw

pct_pct.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, saving("<dir>/tw_pct%%x.gph", replace) nodraw

pipe.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, saving("<dir>/tw_a|b.gph", replace) nodraw

semi.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, saving("<dir>/tw_a;b.gph", replace) nodraw
